• One license, unlimited users
• 97% of users report being satisfied
• 15% less chair time per procedure reported
• Quick-start comfort and focus for dental visits

• Protect touchpoints with disposable barriers. (Amazon Link Below)

Who it’s for
General Dentistry, Surgery, Pediatrics, and any specialty that treats patients seated or supine
